title: My smart speaker asked why I moved the sofa 🛋️
style_prompt: dark blue cinematic night, faceless silhouette, fog, minimal interior, no text, no watermark
hook_text: At 2:14 in the morning my smart speaker asked why I had moved the sofa.

scenes.narration: At 2:14 in the morning my smart speaker asked why I had moved the sofa.
I live alone in a small flat. The speaker has never asked me a question in two years. It only ever answers.
I told it I had not moved anything. It said, the sofa is closer to your bed than it was an hour ago.
I turned the lamp on and laughed. My sofa stood by the window, exactly where it always stands, three metres from my bed.
Then the speaker said, no, the other sofa. I only own one sofa.
The light on top of the speaker turned from blue to red. In the dark corner by the door, old leather creaked, the way it does when somebody sits down slowly.
I opened the app on my phone and read the history. Every night for a month, at 2:14, my own voice had said the same thing. Please put the sofa back.
I do not remember saying it once. Tonight my voice said something new. Do not turn round, I am already sitting on it.
So tell me. Do you turn round, or stare at the screen?
